studies.officialTitle: A Phase 1c Study of XW003 in Chinese Adults With Overweight or Obesity

design.masking: Double-blind through Week 14; open-label active-treatment extension
design.description: Two once-weekly ecnoglutide dose groups and placebo were evaluated through Week 14; active-treatment participants continued through Week 26.

studies.population: Chinese adults with overweight or obesity.
studies.safetySummary: No drug-related serious adverse event or grade 3 or higher adverse event was reported; one serious treatment-emergent acute appendicitis event in the 2.4 mg group was assessed as unrelated.

sources.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ecnoglutide (XW003) in Chinese Adults with Overweight or Obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Open-label, Randomised, Dose-Finding Study of XW003, Once-Weekly Human Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Analogue, Compared With Once-Daily Liraglutide 3 mg in Adult Participants With Obesity

design.description: Four-arm dose-finding study of three once-weekly ecnoglutide target doses versus once-daily liraglutide 3 mg.

studies.population: Adults with obesity in Australia and New Zealand.
studies.safetySummary: Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 93.5% of pooled ecnoglutide participants and 98.0% of liraglutide participants; gastrointestinal events were mostly mild or moderate. Two treatment-related serious acute cholecystitis events occurred, one with ecnoglutide 1.2 mg and one with liraglutide.

sources.title: Efficacy and Safety of Ecnoglutide versus Liraglutide in Adults with Obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Multi-center, Randomized, Double-Blind and Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of XW003 in Adults With Overweight or Obesity (SLIMMER)

design.description: Three ecnoglutide dose cohorts, each with a protocol-defined matching placebo arm; the efficacy publication pooled the three placebo arms.

studies.population: Chinese adults with overweight or obesity, without diabetes.
studies.safetySummary: Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 93% of participants in each ecnoglutide dose group and 84% of pooled placebo participants; gastrointestinal events were generally mild or moderate, and 10 ecnoglutide participants discontinued because of adverse events.

sources.title: Efficacy and safety of a biased GLP-1 receptor agonist ecnoglutide in adults with overweight or obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label, Treatment Switching Phase II Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of XW003 Injection and Semaglutide Injection in Chinese Adults With Obesity

design.description: Treatment-switching comparison of once-weekly ecnoglutide and semaglutide, including dose escalation, core treatment and extension periods.

studies.safetySummary: At Week 20, both treatments were reported as well tolerated and gastrointestinal events were predominantly mild or moderate; nausea occurred in 13.4% versus 21.0% and vomiting in 11.0% versus 12.3% with ecnoglutide versus semaglutide.

sources.title: Ecnoglutide versus Semaglutide in Chinese Adults with Obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase Ib Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Multiple Dosing of XW003 Injection in Chinese Adolescents With Obesity

design.description: Three multiple-dose ecnoglutide cohorts and matching placebo.

studies.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Multiple-dose Escalation, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase Ib/IIa Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Oral Ecnoglutide Tablets in Chinese Participants With Overweight or Obesity

design.description: Four multiple-dose oral ecnoglutide cohorts using once-daily or once-weekly dosing and two frequency-matched placebo cohorts.

studies.population: Chinese adults with overweight or obesity.

studies.officialTitle: A Multi-center, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase III Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of XW003 Injections in Obese Participants With Obstructive Sleep Apnea But Not Receive Positive Airway Pressure Therapy

design.description: Once-weekly ecnoglutide or matching placebo in participants not receiving positive airway pressure therapy.

studies.population: Adults with obesity and obstructive sleep apnea who are not receiving positive airway pressure therapy.

design.description: Once-weekly ecnoglutide or matching placebo in participants receiving positive airway pressure therapy.

studies.population: Adults with obesity and obstructive sleep apnea who are receiving positive airway pressure therapy.

design.description: Once-weekly ecnoglutide or matching placebo with co-primary knee-pain and body-weight objectives.

studies.population: Adults with obesity and knee osteoarthritis.
